title: APS 2.8.2.18 Sprit distance timestamp error in the timer
body:
There is a periodic error in the timer when bolusing meals via the bolus suggestion calculator with a syringe interval. Carbohydrates were triggered with an interval of 10 minutes, in the timer these 10 minutes were not set but only 1 minute. In the APS main screen and treatment tab everything was booked and set correctly. Only affects the timer for the carbohydrate intake.

If I can trace it correctly, this error occurred for the first time with the build: aee036e2 from 29.12.2021.

Enclosed are the corresponding screnshots and log file.

With the request to check, and best thanks Thomas
